 -------------------------------------------
 W.P(C).No.31536 of 2015
 -------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 11th day of January, 2024
 Judgment 
The above Writ Petition is filed with the following prayers:
1.To call for the records leading to Ext P4 and to quash the same by issuing a writ of Certiorari. 
2. To issue a Writ of mandamus commanding the second respondent to finalize the proceedings in Ext P4 in the light of Ext P5 and after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. 
[SIC]
2. The petitioner is aggrieved by Ext.P4 show cause notice, by which, a soda manufacturing unit of the petitioner is directed to be stopped. The petitioner submitted Ext.P5 after Ext.P4.
3. When the matter came up for consideration, this Court passed an interim stay of the operation of Ext.P4 and that order is in force even now. In Ext.P4 itself, it is stated that the petitioner can submit the objection and accordingly, Ext.P5 is submitted by the petitioner. If that is the case, Ext.P5 can be directed to be considered W.P(C).31536/2015 within a time frame and till then, the interim order already passed can continue. 
Therefore, this Writ Petition is disposed of with the following directions:
a) The 1st respondent is directed to consider and pass appropriate orders in Ext.P5,
after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, as expeditiously as possible,
at any rate within six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment. 
b) Till final orders are passed as directed above, the operation of Ext.P4 order shall be kept in abeyance. 
Sd/-
P. V.
